name: team_planning_fork_scenario
description: Fork a scenario in a Team Planning plan. relation 'then' adds the step after parent_id: it starts the day after its parent ends, and ends on ends_on or, without one, runs with no end date. After the baseline it starts on starts_on, on or after the plan's base date and defaulting to it; the days before it read as today. After a parent with no end date it starts on starts_on, which is required, and the parent ends the day before. relation 'instead' adds an alternative to parent_id over the same period. parent_id defaults to the baseline, whose id is the plan's. A parent has at most one 'then' step. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors.

name.description: What the scenario is, such as 'Lean Q1'. Don't put a person's name in it.
